title: observability#langfuse
description: Configure Langfuse for an existing Python Strands HTTP agent using AgentCore zip deployment, IAM, and CDK

agent.description: Agent component name; required when the project contains multiple Python agents

mode.description: Export application traces to Langfuse, or restore the generated CloudWatch exporter

host.description: Langfuse HTTPS base URL, including any self-hosted path prefix. Defaults to https://cloud.langfuse.com on first use; re-runs retain the previous value.

secretArn.description: Complete ARN of an existing Secrets Manager secret containing LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY. Required when first enabling Langfuse; never pass key values.
